title: Unsupervised learning of object landmarks by factorized spatial embeddings
what_they_assume: Landmarks emerge from equivariance to KNOWN synthetic warps (supervised transform); no dynamics/operator.

title: Unsupervised learning of object landmarks through conditional image generation
what_they_assume: Landmarks are bottleneck for RECONSTRUCTING target from source appearance; needs a generator/decoder.

title: Unsupervised discovery of object landmarks as structural representations
what_they_assume: Landmarks as structural bottleneck for autoencoding (reconstruction); no transformation operator.

title: Unsupervised part-based disentangling of object shape and appearance
what_they_assume: Disentangles shape (landmarks) vs appearance via reconstruction + known transforms.

title: Unsupervised learning of landmarks by descriptor vector exchange
what_they_assume: Dense descriptor equivariance under known warps; correspondence, not dynamics.

title: Discovery of latent 3D keypoints via end-to-end geometric reasoning (KeypointNet)
what_they_assume: 3D keypoints from KNOWN relative pose between two views (multi-view geometry supervision).

title: Unsupervised learning of object keypoints for perception and control (Transporter)
what_they_assume: Keypoints via feature TRANSPORT + image reconstruction across frames; RL downstream, no explicit operator.

title: Unsupervised learning of object structure and dynamics from videos
what_they_assume: Keypoints + learned dynamics via a stochastic decoder that RECONSTRUCTS video (VRNN over keypoints).

title: Unsupervised learning of visual 3D keypoints for control
what_they_assume: 3D keypoints for RL control; reconstruction + multi-view, keypoints serve policy not operator linearity.

title: Self-supervised keypoint discovery in behavioral videos (B-KinD)
what_they_assume: Keypoints from spatiotemporal RECONSTRUCTION difference; behavior, not a transformation operator.

title: BKinD-3D: self-supervised 3D keypoint discovery from multi-view videos
what_they_assume: 3D keypoints via multi-view reconstruction; no learned linear operator over keypoints.

title: Group equivariant convolutional networks (G-CNN)
what_they_assume: Equivariance BUILT IN by construction for a KNOWN group; not discovered from data.

title: Harmonic networks: deep translation and rotation equivariance
what_they_assume: Continuous SO(2) equivariance hard-wired via circular harmonics; group known a priori.

title: Dynamic routing between capsules
what_they_assume: Pose encoded in capsule activations via routing; architectural prior, no explicit learned operator.

title: Equivariance with learned canonicalization functions
what_they_assume: Achieves equivariance by learning to CANONICALIZE input pose; group still specified.

title: Equivariant representation learning via class-pose decomposition
what_they_assume: Splits latent into invariant class + equivariant pose on a known group manifold; reconstruction-based.

title: Embed to control: locally linear latent dynamics from raw images (E2C)
what_they_assume: Learns latent where dynamics are LOCALLY linear for control; via reconstruction VAE, latent not keypoints.

title: Learning Koopman invariant subspaces for dynamic mode decomposition
what_they_assume: Learns embedding where dynamics are GLOBALLY linear (Koopman); reconstruction of observables, high-dim lift.

title: Deep learning for universal linear embeddings of nonlinear dynamics
what_they_assume: Autoencoder to Koopman eigenfunctions; linear operator in a LIFTED latent, reconstruction-based.

title: Towards a definition of disentangled representations
authors: Higgins, Amos, Pfau, Racaniere, et al.
what_they_assume: Defines disentanglement via group-action decomposition; conceptual, assumes group is given.

title: Meta-learning symmetries by reparameterization
what_they_assume: DISCOVERS equivariance structure (weight-sharing) from data across tasks; not keypoint/spatial.

title: Automatic symmetry discovery with Lie algebra convolutional network (L-conv)
what_they_assume: Discovers Lie-algebra generators from data; operates on features, needs full representation.

title: Generative adversarial symmetry discovery (LieGAN)
what_they_assume: Discovers symmetry group generators via GAN; GENERATIVE (needs to model full data distribution).

title: Homomorphism autoencoder — learning group structured representations
what_they_assume: Learns group-structured latent from action sequences; RECONSTRUCTION autoencoder, latent not keypoints.

title: The art of making problems simple: a theory of intelligence
what_they_assume: Theory: intelligence = building representational normal forms via generator discovery + quotienting. Demo uses KNOWN TDW transforms, latent orbit-pooling, not keypoints.

title: Geometric regularization of representation spaces enables efficient application of cognitive operators
what_they_assume: VAE latent + curvature regularization for locally-linear operators on mental rotation (SO(3)); reconstruction-based, latent not keypoints.

title: Plannable approximations to MDP homomorphisms: equivariance under actions
authors: van der Pol, Kipf, Oliehoek, Welling
what_they_assume: Learns action-equivariant latent (MDP homomorphism); RL abstraction, latent not spatial keypoints.

title: Network Dissection: Quantifying Interpretability of Deep Visual Representations
what_they_assume: Localized interpretable units emerge in CNNs without supervision, but only DESCRIBES emergence; no operator, no functional account of why.

title: Object-Centric Learning with Slot Attention
authors: Locatello, Weissenborn, Unterthiner, Mahendran, Heigold, Uszkoreit, Dosovitskiy, Kipf
what_they_assume: Object-centric slots emerge from a reconstruction/attention bottleneck; no transformation operator, no operator-legibility account.

title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers (DINO)
authors: Caron, Touvron, Misra, Jegou, Mairal, Bojanowski, Joulin
what_they_assume: Localized semantic attention emerges in self-supervised ViTs; emergence observed, not explained via operator simplicity.

title: Neural Fourier Transform: A General Approach to Equivariant Representation Learning
what_they_assume: Linearizing reps admit many harmonics; capacity-limited latents select dominant irreps GIVEN a fixed invariant kernel. Closest prior art to the irrep-selection claim; does NOT address physical k=1 pinning of keypoints or keypoint-vs-latent comparison.

title: Koopman Invariants as Drivers of Emergent Time-Series Clustering in JEPAs
what_they_assume: A near-identity LINEAR predictor forces the encoder to learn Koopman invariants. Same MECHANISM as this work (linear-predictability selects structured latents) but time-series, not pixels; no keypoints; no irrep-selection. Pedigree, not scoop.

title: Unsupervised Keypoints from Pretrained Diffusion Models
authors: Hedlin, Sharma, Mahajan, He, Isack, Kar, Rhodin, Tagliasacchi, Yi
what_they_assume: Modern keypoint correspondence now comes from frozen diffusion/DINO features, not bespoke CNNs. Field-maturity marker: compete on MECHANISM, not localization. NOTE: ID not re-verified this session (arXiv timeout).

title: AlphaPose: Whole-Body Regional Multi-Person Pose Estimation and Tracking in Real-Time
authors: Fang, Li, Tang, Xu, Zhu, et al.
what_they_assume: Documents soft-argmax estimator bias (asymmetric-gradient, size-dependent scoring) — candidate cause of operator singular values <1 and the small angle bias. Estimator pathology, not objective-level degeneracy.
